summary.text: Randy Burckhard is a Republican member of the North Dakota Senate representing District 5 (Minot), serving since 2011. His standing committees in the 2025 regular session are Appropriations.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Burckhard is a retired SRT Communications executive.

His biography lists past service as president of the Minot Convention and Visitors Bureau and the MSU Alumni Association, past chair of the Minot Area Chamber of Commerce, membership on the Minot City Council, and service on the MSU Board of Regents.
It lists him as President Pro Tempore in 2021, and in the interim he chairs the Government Finance Committee.
His biography lists him as married to Pat, with three children and nine grandchildren.
